parameters.query: INSERT INTO approval_requests (approval_id, approval_type, title, description, requested_by, client_id, approval_chain, current_step, status, data, expires_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.approval_id }}', '{{ $json.approval_type }}', '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ ($json.description || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $json.requested_by }}', {{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, '{{ JSON.stringify($json.approval_chain) }}'::jsonb, 0, 'pending', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.data) }}'::jsonb, '{{ $json.expires_at }}') RETURNING *

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, approval_id: $json.approval_id, status: 'pending', approval_chain: $json.approval_chain }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE approval_requests SET status = '{{ $json.decision }}', current_step = current_step + 1, data = data || '{"decision_by": "{{ $json.decided_by }}", "decision_reason": "{{ $json.reason }}", "decided_at": "{{ new Date().toISOString() }}"}'::jsonb WHERE approval_id = '{{ $json.approval_id }}' AND status = 'pending' RETURNING *

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, approval_id: $node['Parse Response'].json.approval_id, status: $node['Parse Response'].json.decision }) }}
